thread:
maya: FYI escalated ticket from Saffron — after we cut over to saffron-v1 (new tokenizer) they see a big tail. p95 from ~220ms -> ~1.4s, p99 from ~600ms -> ~5.2s, and some 504s. Happening mostly on long inputs (>40k chars). Ticket #4532. Attaching logs snippet below. :exclamation:

leo: Can you paste a minimal repro request and the exact model name they hit? Is this only on Dedicated or also Hosted?

maya: They hit their Dedicated pool in us-west-2. Model header: saffron-v1. Example curl we gave them to repro (sanitized):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLACED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"saffron-v1","input":"<~60k chars text...>","max_output_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

They saw a few warm requests fast but many long ones hit the long tail. Logs show big tokenize time on some requests.

anika: Quick ML notes — we onboarded saffron-bpe-v2 tokenizer during the model swap (intended to fix some CJK edgecases). That tokenizer changes merge heuristics which increases the number of splits for certain long documents and interacts poorly with our prefix normalization path. I suspect tokenize time + extra KV-cache churn is the culprit.

chao: Pulled traces for the pool and correlated. Sample span breakdown from a slow request: `tokenize: 3.8s | kvcache-lookup+invalidations: 1.1s | runtime (decode): 1.2s | network overhead: 0.15s` — total ~6.25s. Most of the variance is tokenize + kvcache. Console shows kvcache invalidation spikes aligned with tokenizer variant rollout.

leo: Good catch. Is the tokenizer causing more token count or just slower per-token CPU? Any difference in token length?

anika: It's both — average token count increased ~8% on their failing corpus and normalization path does more regex passes. On top of that our KV cache key derivation includes a tokenizer fingerprint; changes cause cache misses that trigger recompute.

maya: Customer can reproduce locally and provided a small test payload. I validated locally and hit tokenize ~2.9s on one sample with saffron-bpe-v2, versus ~0.35s with saffron-bpe-legacy.

chao: Current mitigation options I see:
- Roll back routing for Saffron to saffron-v1-legacy (tokenizer legacy variant) for their Dedicated pool (fastest mitigation).
- Temporarily cap max_input_length via per-customer routing rule (e.g., 32k chars) to reduce worst-case tokenize work.
- Disable tokenizer fingerprinting for kvcache key generation (risk: cache collisions across variants) — needs careful testing.
- Revert tokenizer change in the model bundle and re-run onboard with optimized normalization.

leo: I'd prefer rollback to legacy tokenizer for that pool while ML does a tokenizer patch. Chao — can you patch route and run a small canary? Ops-bot shows we can config route override.

ops-bot: autoconfig: routed saffron-dedicated-pool-17 -> saffron-v1-legacy (canary target 10%) by @leo request. :gear:

chao: Canary in place. Running 1k synthetic requests against their failing payload set now (using load-tool). I'll post results in ~10m.

anika: I'll instrument a quick tokenizer profiler and push a branch that reduces normalization passes. If we can drop per-request regex complexity we should shave most of the tokenize time. I also have a patch to stop including tokenizer fingerprint in KV key when the model is pinned to the same major family. Needs review.

maya: Also seeing a handful of 504s correlated to our client library retry policy when tokenizer spikes hit our request timeout. Customer asked for a temporary fallback to lower-latency model (saffron-lite) while we fix this — they are okay with slightly reduced quality.

leo: Action items:
- chao (SRE): complete canary and if green, flip 100% route for saffron-dedicated-pool-17 to legacy tonight. (ETA 3h)
- anika (ML): validate tokenizer patch & KV-key change, create rollout plan for tokenizer rebuild. (ETA 1d)
- maya (Support): confirm customer fallback to saffron-lite and coordinate communication. (ETA 2h)

chao: Canary results after 1k requests:  p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms, error rate dropped to 0.1%. Looks much improved vs baseline. Rolling to 100% now.

ops-bot: autoconfig: routed saffron-dedicated-pool-17 -> saffron-v1-legacy (100%) by @chao. :white_check_mark:

maya: Customer notified — they report immediate improvement in latency and dropped 504s in first 30m. They're comfortable waiting for ML's patch and then a controlled re-onboard. :thumbsup:

anika: I'll open PR for tokenizer perf fixes and add unit tests covering long documents and CJK cases. I'll also run the KV-key experiment behind a feature flag. Will ping here when PR is ready for review.

leo: Nice coordinated response — please add postmortem note to incidents channel after ML rollout with concrete numbers and the change that fixed it.

maya: Will follow up. Closing loop with Saffron and updating ticket #4532. Thanks team. :pray:
